name: Invesco
description: Invesco manages $2.17 trillion for retail and institutional clients and earns an annual percentage fee on the assets, so revenue tracks market levels and net inflows. About 29 percent of AUM is in ETFs and index funds, 19 percent in the QQQ Nasdaq-100 ETF, and a further 6 percent in a China joint venture; active equity is only 14 percent. In 2025 it recorded a $1.79 billion non-cash write-down of mutual-fund management contracts bought in the OppenheimerFunds deal, which turned GAAP operating income negative (-$695.7M) even though adjusted operating income rose to $1,557.8M. It has about $2.5 billion of perpetual preferred stock outstanding, issued for that acquisition.

employees.note: 7,499 employees (8,508 a year earlier), in over 20 countries.

businessLines.name: ETFs and Index
businessLines.how: Annual fee on passive ETF and index-fund assets, lower fee rate than active; grows with inflows and market levels.

businessLines.name: QQQ (Nasdaq-100 ETF)
businessLines.how: Fee on assets in the QQQ ETF; converted from a unit investment trust to an open-end fund on 2025-12-20, which the company says lets it generate new revenue.

businessLines.name: Fundamental Fixed Income
businessLines.how: Annual percentage fee on actively managed bond assets.

businessLines.name: Fundamental Equities
businessLines.how: Annual percentage fee on actively managed equity assets (highest fee rate; net outflows of $21.1B in 2025).

businessLines.name: Global Liquidity (money market)
businessLines.how: Small fee on money market fund assets; low fee rate.

businessLines.name: China JV (Invesco Great Wall)
businessLines.how: Invesco shows 100 percent of the joint venture in non-GAAP net revenues ($364.0M in 2025, average AUM $109.0B) though it holds a minority stake; GAAP shows only its share as equity earnings.

businessLines.name: Private Markets
businessLines.how: Fees on private credit, real estate and other alternatives; partnerships with Barings (MassMutual) and LGT Capital Partners announced to build wealth-channel products.

businessLines.name: Multi-Asset/Other
businessLines.how: Fee on balanced and multi-asset portfolios.
